description:
A missão de um advogado criminalista é ser um defensor atualizado e dedicado aos clientes, sempre agindo dentro dos limites da lei e respeitando os mais altos padrões éticos da advocacia.

1. Atuação Judicial:

  • Propor Ações: Atuar em processos judiciais, como ações de cobrança, indenização por danos, dissolução de sociedade, revisão de contratos, entre outras.
  • Defender em Ações: Defender clientes em processos judiciais, incluir contrarrazões, defender recursos, elaborar petições iniciais e acompanhar processualmente.
  • Executar Sentenças: Auxiliar na execução de sentenças judiciais, como cobrar dívidas ou cumprir decisões de natureza alimentar, familiar ou contratual.
  • Atuar em Ações Cautelares: Em situações urgentes, atuar em medidas cautelares, como requerer tutela antecipada, arresto ou sequestro de bens, para assegurar o resultado de um processo.
  • Acompanhar Litígios: Representar o cliente em audiências de conciliação, instrução e julgamento, além de elaborar estratégias jurídicas para o andamento dos processos.

2. Atuação Extrajudicial:

- Prestar Consultoria Jurídica: Orientar preventivamente sobre direitos e deveres do cliente, visar evitar litígios e prevenir problemas legais.

  • Negociar Acordos: Mediar e negociar entre as partes envolvidas em um conflito, buscar soluções amigáveis para evitar o processo judicial. Aplicar em questões de família, contratos, disputas entre empresas, entre outras.
  • Elaborar e Revisar Contratos: Redigir contratos de compra e venda, prestação de serviços, locação, sociedades, acordos comerciais etc., assegurar que as cláusulas estejam conforme a legislação e protejam os interesses das partes envolvidas.
  • Formalizar Acordos: Elaborar termos de acordo, escrituras públicas, distratos, ajustes entre partes, visar formalizar soluções extrajudiciais e evitar litígios.
  • Atuar em Acordos de Mediação e Arbitragem: Caso as partes optem por soluções alternativas de resolução de disputas, atuar em processos de mediação e arbitragem.

3. Redação de Documentos:

- Elaborar Contratos: Elaborar e revisar contratos de diferentes naturezas, como comerciais, de prestação de serviços, de parceria, entre outros.

  • Redigir Testamentos e Escrituras Públicas: Elaborar testamentos, escrituras públicas de compra e venda, doações, entre outros documentos legais.
  • Elaborar Notificações e Petições: Redigir notificações extrajudiciais, petições e solicitações diversas, como notificações de inadimplência ou de cobrança.
  • Preparar Distratos e Aditivos Contratuais: Elaborar documentos que formalizam a alteração ou rescisão de contratos existentes.

4. Negociações e Resolução de Conflitos:

- Negociar Dívidas e Condições de Pagamento: Intermediar negociações de dívidas, propor acordos que facilitem o pagamento e evitem ações judiciais.

  • Resolver Disputas de Propriedade: Negociar acordos entre as partes envolvidas em disputas de posse ou propriedade, como acordos de condomínio ou regularização de imóveis.
  • Mediar Acordos de Família: Em questões familiares (como divórcios e partilhas), atuar na negociação de acordos amigáveis, sem a necessidade de litígio judicial.
  • Participar em Mediação e Arbitragem: Atuar em processos de mediação e arbitragem, métodos alternativos para resolução de conflitos sem recorrer ao judiciário.

5. Assessoria e Planejamento:

- Planejar Patrimônio: Prestar consultoria na organização e planejamento de patrimônio, como planejar sucessão e gerir bens em vida.

  • Assessorar sobre Direitos de Consumo e Empresas: Orientar sobre as melhores práticas e direitos relacionados ao consumidor e às relações empresariais, prevenir conflitos e ações judiciais.
  • Orientar sobre Responsabilidade Civil: Assessorar sobre situações de risco à responsabilidade civil, como acidentes, danos causados a terceiros e outras implicações legais.

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

No âmbito da parceria com a Enel Distribuição São Paulo e Ceará, a AVSI Brasil atuará a partir de 2025 na execução e formatação sistemática do PROGRAMA ECOENEL - Troca de resíduos por bônus na conta de energia. Esta iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O/a Coordenador Operacional atuará no monitoramento e análise de dados do projeto, apoiando na elaboração de relatórios periódicos de desempenho das metas e demais atividades administrativas do projeto. Além disso, ficará responsável pela coordenação da equipe operacional e relacionamento com o cliente.

  1. Coordenar as atividades operacionais e administrativas referentes ao projeto e à equipe;
  2. Coordenar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI;

  7. Coordenar os processos administrativos para aquisições de materiais, contratação de serviços e gestão de pessoas zelando pela correta aplicação dos procedimentos administrativos da AVSI Brasil, e em conformidade ao Plano de Aquisições do projeto;

title: Mgr,ASU Supply Chain Plng
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for tactical and operational supply chain planning and network optimization of bulk ASU products (LIN, LOX and LAR) in US and Canada.
  • Identify and assess longer term projects/opportunities that deliver cost savings, productivity, and efficiency improvements in the ASU supply chain.
  • Provides key supply chain input to strategic growth initiatives.
  • This position is the primary interface between Supply and the field sales organizations to understand changes in current and future demand and to ensure the supply network is prepared to serve that demand at the lowest overall delivered cost.

Primary Interface between Markets/Sales, Strategic Product Management, and Operations for ASU products:

  • Primary day-to-day interface with account managers and regional Markets leadership on understanding changes in customer demand that will affect supply network configuration.
  • Provide product availability and costing analyses to Strategic Product Management for over DOA-based new business and investment case analyses and senior management for overall business management.
  • Executes ASU energy and diesel surcharge policy defined by Strategic Product Management and Markets based on major cost changes within the network.
  • Support Tonnage account managers on liquid back-up or supplemental concerns (volume availability and costing).

Tactical Supply Chain Planning and Optimization:

  • Assigns plant production rates, operating modes and inventory targets in collaboration with Remote Operating Center engineers and Energy Procurement team to minimize overall product costs. This includes day-of plant turndowns/shutdowns to meet power reduction obligations and minimize/avoid peak power costs.
  • Responsible for coordinating with scheduling teams on inventory vs alternate sourcing needs to minimize impact to customers.
  • Ensures all mid- and long-term purchase agreements are utilized based on lowest total incremental costs.
  • Responsible for development, use and compliance to proprietary network optimization systems (TACT), including quality of inputs and adherence to outputs.
  • Execute supply reviews with Supply field regions and develop operational plans for Sales and Operations Planning. Sets transport resource levels required to fulfill plan while minimizing assets and costs.

Operative Supply Chain Response:

  • Responsible for ensuring sufficient inventory for all pipeline demand (gaseous) and internal plant uses through inventory planning via plant mode changes, liquid product transfers between storage tanks, liquid imports (as required) and/or coordinating deliveries from third parties.
  • Plan, track and own the outage process for ASU. Includes developing plans, forecasting and tracking costs, and providing timely communication on the status of the network during planned and unplanned outages.

Systems Usage & Maintenance:

  • Parcview, J5, Telemetry
  • TACT, Optimizer and potential new, future network optimization tools
  • Sales and Operations Planning including Demand Planning tools
  • SAP and GOLD
  • SAP Analytics Cloud for data visualization

Others:

  • Supervises ASU logistics analyst who is responsible for immediate term coordination of supply network, managing finished product inventories and take-or-pays and FOB (pickup) customers.
  • Responsible for developing key operational assumptions and associated costs for the annual budgeting process and ongoing reforecasts, including purchases, rail shipments, planned outage (dislocation) costs.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in logistics, supply chain, business or engineering.
  • Minimum of 7 years experience in industrial gases or related process industry with supply chain management experience.
  • C.P., M.B.A. and six sigma certifications are a plus.

Required key skills:

  • Strong strategic and tactical thinking are required to analyze and manage a dynamic national network.
  • Must have strong Microsoft Office skills, especially in Excel, Power Point and Word.
  • SAP skills are required.
  • Strong, effective communications are required.
  • Ideal candidate would understand when to push issues and when to let a system work to correct it.
  • Strong prioritization management skills are a must.

Required critical behaviors:

  • Critical
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Information Sharing
  • Change Management
  • Growth Drive
  • Capability Development
  • Supportive
  • Partnership Building

About Messer:

Messer’s safety culture, commitment to providing dependable supply and innovative gas technology solutions help customers unlock opportunities to be safer, more sustainable, more productive and more efficient, so their business thrives. We nurture lasting, meaningful relationships with customers, our communities, and with one another.

We offer comprehensive benefits and appreciable pay, with steady schedules and opportunities for ongoing training and career progression. We prioritize and invest in our people at every level of our organization – the dedication, knowledge, customer focus and entrepreneurial spirit of our employees is what make Messer refreshingly different.

description:
Research Scientist in Microbial Genetic and Metabolic Engineering (Biocontrol)

Last updated on May 8, 2025

WHO WE ARE

Symbiomics is a biotechnology startup focused on developing high-performance biological products containing efficient microbes for multiple applications in agriculture. Our mission is to develop creative solutions in the field of biologicals using cutting-edge scientific knowledge to create products that sustainably increase agricultural productivity. We value our team as a central part of this process! Every team member is encouraged to be bold in their ideas, challenge dogmas, and explore new ways to solve big problems. We believe that a collaborative and dynamic environment is essential for innovation.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Share Symbiomics’ mission and vision for a more sustainable future!
  • Motivated by new challenges and have a drive for innovative ideas that directly impact global agricultural issues
  • Looking for an emerging company that allows you to achieve great goals.
  • Team player who knows how to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Aware of the responsibility of delivering excellent work!

ABOUT THIS JOB

We are seeking a highly qualified research scientist to join our R&D team and contribute to the development of genetic and metabolic engineering strategies applied to microorganisms with biocontrol potential. The professional will be responsible for the construction and characterization of genetically modified microbial strains, focusing on the creation of innovative products to combat agricultural pathogens and pests. The candidate will have access to Symbiomics’ culture collections and technological platform, aiming to develop disruptive biological products alongside a highly skilled team. Their role will be centered on:

  • Design, develop, and apply tools for precision genetic optimization and heterologous/homologous gene expression in model and non-model microorganisms.
  • Outline and implement different genetic modification strategies to modulate metabolic pathways in model and non-model microorganisms with a focus on pathogen biocontrol.
  • Design vectors for genetic modification and gene expression (heterologous/homologous) in microorganisms using multiple genetic engineering strategies.
  • Identify and modulate metabolic pathways involved in the production of bioactive metabolites.
  • Perform phenotypic and functional characterization of modified strains, including in vitro and in planta .
  • Contribute to the implementation of new Molecular Biology technologies, including hands-on laboratory work and data analysis, as needed.
  • Assist teams in daily activities to ensure high standards of scientific quality and compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), protocols, and safety principles.
  • Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, including Microbiology, Molecular Biology, and Bioinformatics, to execute projects.
  • Maintain organized and detailed records of protocols, experiments, and results.
  • Contribute to the company’s success with new insights and ideas!

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS

  • MSc and/or PhD in a relevant field such as Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, or related fields, or professional experience demonstrating expertise.
  • Proven hands-on experience with genetic engineering techniques, including genetic editing (homologous recombination, CRISPR, etc.), cloning, and heterologous/homologous expression.
  • Ability to develop and apply molecular tools for genetic engineering of model and non-model organisms.
  • Experience in vector design, validation, and cloning systems.
  • Experience with bacterial handling, storing, and reactivation procedures.
  • Strategic planning skills, problem-solving ability, critical thinking, and autonomy.
  • Knowledge of general procedures and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) involving Microbiology and Molecular Biology.
  • Strong communication skills, teamwork, and an innovative mindset.
  • Experience with genome editing of non-model microorganisms.
  • Knowledge of microbial metabolism, biosynthetic pathway modulation, and gene expression regulation.
  • Experience in designing and assembling synthetic gene circuits to program and control cellular functions (Synthetic Biology).

INFORMATION

Department: R&D

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Food, meal, and transportation allowances, along with other benefits.
  • Health insurance.
  • Competitive salary aligned with the market and based on experience.
  • A diverse, dynamic, and innovative work environment, with access to cutting-edge technologies.
  • The opportunity to work in a highly qualified, engaged, and collaborative team.

title: Planning and Scheduling Team Manager
description:

5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Planning and Scheduling Team Manager role at Air Products

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM - providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our customers globally. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include compressor loaded turbo-expanders, generator-loaded power recovery expanders, and low-cost dissipative expanders. We offer new equipment designs, rerates, upgrades and repair along with field services, engineering evaluations, reliability, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, shop services, and new equipment replacements for all types of centrifugal and reciprocating equipment. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
Gardner Cryogenics designs and manufactures high-performance, highly reliable, long-lasting storage tanks used to transport hydrogen and helium molecules around the globe. With more than six decades of experience, Gardner provides customers with industry-leading technology that enables them to cost-effectively move and store molecules with near zero loss. The unique technology developed by Gardner provides the lowest heat-leak for the highest yield when transporting, storing, and transferring helium and hydrogen.
We are seeking a results-oriented Planning and Scheduling Team Manager for our Gardner Cryogenics and Rotoflow manufacturing facilities, within the Lehigh Valley, PA. This position will be responsible for managing planning and scheduling team and overseeing the entire process from new order intake through delivery of contract, including aggregating information for resource planning, reporting of on-time delivery metrics, and helping to drive process improvements in the speed of execution, process efficiency and fulfilment of orders. This position interfaces closely with Sales and Proposals, Manufacturing, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement and Supply Chain to ensure execution and manufacturing dates are being met. This position will be located in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania and will split time between the Rotoflow and Gardner facilities.
What's In It For You
At Air Products we foster a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard, and everyone feels they belong and matter. Additionally, we offer competitive pay and great benefits for our employees. Check out some of our benefits below!

  • Affordable Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (day 1 of employment)
  • 401k with 100% vested company core and match
  • Paid Vacation, holidays + sick time
  • Paid Parental leave (Up to 8 weeks)
  • Backup Child and Adult Care benefit
  • Adoption assistance
  • Flexible spending accounts (medical, dependent daycare)
  • Life Insurance (AD&D- Paid for by Air Products), Supplemental AD&D
  • Legal Plan & Identity theft coverage
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Many more supplemental benefits available
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Leading and developing the team of planners and schedulers across Gardner and Rotoflow,
  • Acting as a mentor, guide, and decision maker for the team to enable peak performance and remove barriers to progress,
  • Conducting performance evaluations and direct day-to-day management of team members,
  • Setting overarching goals, objectives, and development plans for the team and team members aligned with leadership cascaded goals,
  • Driving the team to efficiently and effectively plan and schedule activities aligned with Project Management milestones and delivery schedules,
  • Owning and driving enhancement and improving accuracy of the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
  • Translating sales opportunity pipeline into workforce and facility demand and capacity planning and scheduling (S&OP),
  • Working closely with Sales and Proposals to anticipate order timing and align proposal schedules and deliveries with current workload, supplier loading and availability, and facility capacity to ensure appropriate customer deliveries are achievable,
  • Setting priorities, finding solutions, and collaborating with all disciplines within the business to enable the faithful execution of work,
  • Driving the optimization of plans and schedules based on inputs (part availability, resource availability, work center availability, etc.) to accommodate unplanned or unforeseen circumstances such as customer emergencies,
  • Developing a world class planning and scheduling work processes, systems, and tools to enable efficient and effective execution of all aspects of work aligned with the business growth goals,
  • Assessing and resolving limitations, gaps, constraints, bottlenecks, delays, and other unplanned barriers impacting engineering and manufacturing,
  • Leading production meetings,
  • Developing and owning key performance indicators for planning and scheduling and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • B.S. in a technical discipline preferred. Experience considered in lieu of a technical degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of planning and scheduling experience with discrete equipment manufacturing or similar.
  • Prior leadership experience leading a team of direct reports.
  • Exemplify a passion for winning and ability to motivate teams.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Production Planning module preferred.
  • Certifications such as PPM, APICS, ASM, or related are a strong plus.
  • Experience with MS Office Suite, (Excel, Word, Project, Outlook, PowerPoint) required.
  • Broad strategic thinker, with a clear vision and direction to improve business performance.
  • Proven track record for planning and scheduling process improvement and results.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills. Identify and recommend alternative solutions and translate complex concepts into simplified and understandable examples.
  • Detail, goal, and results oriented, organized, creative, self-motivated, collaborative, and customer focused.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills (written, verbal and presentation).
  • Highly effective communication, collaboration, conflict management, performance management, data driven and analytical approach.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and collaboratively with engineers, technicians, and suppliers in shop, office, and field environments.
  • High energy, desire to learn new skills, and desire to understand the specifics of the processes and inter-related steps that are required to fulfil a variety of orders, from design, engineering, procurement, and manufacturing.
  • Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.
Join Air Products, where we proudly value the skills, dedication, and leadership that Veterans bring to the table. As a Veteran-friendly organization, we actively encourage and welcome Veterans to apply for various roles within our company. We recognize the unique strengths and experiences that Veterans contribute, and we foster a workplace that honors your service while providing a platform for professional growth.
We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end-to-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.
At Air Products, we work in an environment where we put safety first, diversity is essential, inclusion is our culture, and each person knows they belong and matter. To learn more, visitAbout Air Products.

  • Experiência com projetos de engenharia de segurança industrial, incluindo: Redes de incêndio (hidrantes, sprinklers e detectores), rotas de fuga, saídas de emergência, sistemas de combate e detecção de incêndios;
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis, como NR-10, NR-13, NR-20, NR-23, NFPA, API e IEC 61511;
  • Boa comunicação técnica e postura para interação com clientes e times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro;
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em outras frentes técnicas da SANDECH, conforme demanda.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Segurança de Processos, Gerenciamento de Riscos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações técnicas específicas em HAZOP, LOPA, FMEA ou normas como NFPA, API, IEC 61511;
  • Experiência anterior em consultorias de engenharia ou empresas do setor industrial com foco em segurança de processos;
  • Familiaridade com softwares de análise de riscos, como PHA Pro, PHAWorks, BowTie XP, entre outros;
  • Conhecimentos de projetos multidisciplinares (ex: processos, instrumentação, automação, layout de plantas industriais);
  • Vivência com clientes de setores regulados, como óleo e gás, químico, petroquímico, papel e celulose, etc.;
  • Inglês técnico (leitura de normas e documentação);
  • Participação em auditorias ou inspeções regulatórias envolvendo segurança de processos ou industrial.

Certificações Obrigatórias:

  • Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho – essencial para atuar com projetos de segurança industrial (exigência legal e técnica);
  • Curso de Facilitador de HAZOP – com carga horária adequada e reconhecimento por instituição especializada (ex: CCPS, TÜV, DNV, SGS, Bureau Veritas ou similar).

Certificações Desejáveis:

  • Certificação NFPA – voltada para combate a incêndio e proteção contra riscos industriais;
  • Certificações em normas técnicas internacionais, como IEC 61511 (Sistemas Instrumentados de Segurança) ou ISA S84;
  • Treinamentos OSHA – voltados para segurança operacional e prevenção de acidentes em ambientes industriais;
  • Certificados complementares em primeiros socorros, combate a incêndio ou resposta a emergências, especialmente para contextos de plantas operacionais.

Ferramentas e Softwares obrigatórios:

Ferramentas e Softwares desejáveis:

  • PHAWorks ou PHA-Pro;

  • ABNT Catálogo Online, Target GEDWeb, NFPA Codes, OSHA ou plataformas similares.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Sobre nós
A Evolucional acredita que o uso de dados pode transformar a educação e o processo de aprendizagem. Atuamos, desde 2014, oferecendo simulados e avaliações para escolas em todo o Brasil. A partir disso, geramos dados precisos sobre o conhecimento dos alunos, e ajudamos as instituições de ensino na transformação da gestão pedagógica.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Participar do planejamento e da arquitetura de aplicações web, definindo estrutura de pastas, padrões de componentes e fluxos de dados.
  • Implementar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, seguindo as melhores práticas de UI/UX.
  • Desenvolver componentes reutilizáveis em ReactJS e/ou Angular, garantindo alta performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST, tratando de forma eficiente requisições assíncronas, autenticação e tratamento de erros.
  • Escrever testes unitários e de integração que garantam robustez e confiabilidade ao código.
  • Conduzir code reviews e tutorias, promovendo qualidade de código e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com designers, back-end e demais times em ciclos de entrega ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em ReactJS e/ou Angular, com projetos entregues em produção.
  • Domínio de JavaScript (ES6+) , incluindo tópicos como promessas, async/await, módulos e closure.
  • HTML5 semântico e CSS3 , com entendimento aprofundado de flexbox, grid e responsividade.
  • Experiência com pré-processadores (SASS) ou bibliotecas de CSS-in-JS (styled-components).
  • Prática na integração de APIs REST : consumo, mapeamento de dados e otimização de requisições.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de projetos front-end, definição de padrões de código e organização de repositórios.
  • Experiência comprovada em code review e aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Habilidade em criar e manter testes unitários para componentes e serviços.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • TypeScript : tipagem estática, generics e uso em projetos complexos.
  • Ferramentas de testes como Jest e Testing Library , com cobertura de testes significativa.
  • Configuração e otimização de bundlers: Webpack , Vite ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis, CI/CD e pipelines de automação (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Experiência com frameworks de design system (Storybook, Bit) ou bibliotecas de UI.

Competências Comportamentais Necessárias

  • Proatividade e senso de dono
  • – Antecipar desafios, sugerir melhorias e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados.
  • Comunicação clara e empática
  • – Transmitir ideias de forma objetiva, ouvir ativamente e dar/receber feedback construtivo.
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe
  • – Compartilhar conhecimento, apoiar colegas em bloqueios e alinhar-se com diferentes áreas (design, back-end, QA).
  • Orientação a resultados
  • – Manter o foco em metas e prazos, equilibrando qualidade de código e entregas ágeis.
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade
  • – Ajustar-se rapidamente a mudanças de requisitos, novas tecnologias e prioridades de negócio.
  • Organização e gestão do tempo
  • – Priorizar tarefas, estimar prazos de forma realista e garantir entregas dentro do planejado.
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo
  • – Buscar ativamente novas ferramentas, frameworks e boas práticas para evoluir o produto e o próprio conhecimento.
  • Resiliência e gestão de pressão
  • – Manter a calma sob prazos apertados, lidar bem com retrabalho e aprender com erros.
  • Empatia com o usuário final
  • – Colocar-se no lugar de quem utiliza a aplicação, garantindo usabilidade, acessibilidade e boa experiência.

Aqui, você vai encontrar um espaço acolhedor, que irá dar oportunidade para que você aprenda e se desenvolva! Fazemos isso por meio de um trabalho em equipe harmonioso, que conta com pessoas qualificadas e abertas a ensinar e aprender, buscando sempre obter os melhores resultados para o time!

title: Analyst, Infrastructure
description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

Position Overview:
Optimize global logistics network efficiency and effectiveness through capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse engineering. This role analyzes infrastructure, mid- and long-term supply plans, and designs agile, cost-effective networks to accommodate growth while maximizing service levels.

Your Key Responsibilities Include:

  1. Conduct detailed analysis of current logistics capacity, including warehouse space, transportation routes, and distribution centers, to identify optimization opportunities. Project mid- and long-term capacity requirements. Monitor KPIs related to logistics capacity and network performance.
  2. Utilize advanced modeling techniques and simulation tools to translate supply plans into optimal logistics networks, considering transportation costs, lead times, inventory levels, and service requirements. Provide short-term analysis and recommendations for resilient network adaptations in response to unplanned capacity or demand changes.
  3. Design and oversee warehouse layout plans to maximize productivity and throughput volumes.
  4. Establish and maintain global MHE (Material Handling Equipment), including automation standards and requirements.
  5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams—commercial, operations, planning, logistics, and finance—to align capacity planning efforts with business objectives.
  6. Lead projects and coordinate stakeholder resources for capacity expansion initiatives, such as warehouse expansions, fleet upgrades, or network reconfigurations.
  7. Regularly review and audit logistics capacity and network performance to ensure alignment with business needs.
  8. Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in logistics capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse design.
  9. Provide guidance and support to logistics team members on capacity planning tools, processes, and methodologies.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent or advanced proficiency in English.
  • Logistics Experience:
    • Experience in logistics operations, including transportation, warehousing, and distribution, with a focus on network optimization strategies.

  • Capacity Planning:

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is a digital-first creative agency that blends technology and creativity to tackle the biggest challenges facing today's brands. They take an outcome-driven, user-centric approach, ensuring that every solution they deliver is both effective and engaging. They are trusted by some of the world's most ambitious brands, including Apple, Nike, T-Mobile, and The Trevor Project, demonstrating their ability to deliver exceptional results for a diverse range of clients.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Production designer.

  • Mastery in Adobe Photoshop and Sketch.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Keynote.

  • Professional digital design experience, bonus if it’s with a marketing agency.

  • Knowledge of design accessibility guidelines.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

ATENÇÃO, CANDIDATA: Gentileza ler com atenção a descrição completa da vaga e se cadastrar apenas se cumprir com os requisitos obrigatórios.

Descrição geral da vaga:

Estamos buscando uma Consultora de RH para o nosso time: Somos uma consultoria com raízes em Belo Horizonte e atuação em todo o Brasil. Nossa equipe é composta por Consultores Associados, especializados em projetos que vão desde a Implantação da área de RH “do zero” até Transformação Cultural, Desenvolvimento de Liderança, Recrutamento e Seleção, entre outros serviços estratégicos focados em Recursos Humanos.

O grande desafio desta posição é atuar liderando projetos e processos de alta complexidade em diversas frentes do RH. A posição envolve a implantação, gestão, execução e acompanhamento de iniciativas robustas nas áreas que envolvem a jornada de experiências do colaborador, tais como cargos e salários, remuneração variável, gestão do clima, gestão do desempenho, trilha de carreira, treinamento e desenvolvimento, recrutamento & seleção e comunicação interna. Será responsável por desenvolver soluções integradas e inovadoras, contribuindo diretamente para o fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e promovendo uma experiência positiva para os colaboradores.

Descrição das atividades:

  1. Implantação da área de RH seguindo as metodologias da consultoria.
  2. Atuar no desenvolvimento, execução e gerenciamento de projetos.
  3. Liderar projetos, administrando custos, escopos e prazos, assegurando o atendimento aos objetivos estratégicos da área.
  4. Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos, incluindo departamentos jurídicos de governança e compliance.
  5. Gerenciar o plano de cargos e salários, analisando promoções, enquadramentos e programas de benefícios.
  6. Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  7. Implantar e administrar programas de avaliação de desempenho, planejamento de carreira e PDI.
  8. Apoiar os líderes nas rotinas e processos de gestão.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  1. Ensino superior completo em RH, Administração, Psicologia ou áreas afins;
  2. Pacote Office intermediário;
  3. Habilidade para conduzir reuniões e articulação com diferentes públicos;
  4. Experiência em áreas generalistas de RH, desenvolvimento de pessoas e gestão de projetos;
  5. Experiência com alta e média liderança.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  1. Pacote Office avançado;
  2. Pós-graduação/MBA em Recursos Humanos, Gestão de Pessoas, Gestão da Mudança, Desenvolvimento de Líderes;
  3. Formação em BP e Coaching Executivo.

description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
Job Summary
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.
As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations
What we are looking for in you
  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Somos uma indústria especializada na fabricação de máquinas para reciclagem de plásticos, reconhecida pelo compromisso com a inovação e pela busca incessante pela qualidade em nossos produtos. Se você é um profissional que valoriza a excelência e deseja atuar em uma empresa que preza pela qualidade acima de tudo, esta é a oportunidade ideal.

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro Projetista altamente capacitado e apaixonado por inovação para integrar nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por criar, desenvolver e validar projetos que atendam às necessidades de nossos clientes, garantindo eficiência e qualidade em cada solução proposta.

• Aplicar conhecimentos técnicos para resolver problemas de design e propor melhorias em produtos existentes;
• Criar modelos 3D e desenhos técnicos detalhados para fabricação;
• Acompanhar o processo de fabricação, garantindo a aderência aos requisitos do projeto;

Requisitos
• Formação em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas;
• Experiência prática com tolerâncias dimensionais e geométricas (GD&T), dobras metálicas e cálculo do fator K;
• Vivência comprovada em validação de projetos, prototipagem e execução de testes funcionais;
• Domínio de softwares de CAD 3D (como SolidWorks, Inventor ou similar);
• Conhecimento em análise estrutural e simulações de desempenho será um diferencial;
• Habilidade para interpretar normas técnicas e aplicar boas práticas de engenharia;
• Experiência na interface com equipes de fabricação e montagem.

Competências Desejadas
• Perfil proativo, com capacidade de propor soluções inovadoras e eficazes;
• Atenção aos detalhes e foco em qualidade;
• Boa comunicação para interação com equipes internas e fornecedores;
• Organização para lidar com prazos e múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Remuneração
• A remuneração será atrativa e compatível com o desempenho demonstrado e será combinado de acordo com o conhecimento técnico.
• O processo seletivo incluirá uma entrevista com o setor de RH, entrevista técnica e, posteriormente, um teste prático para análise de habilidades técnicas e definição salarial.

About the Role

At NinjaOne we are passionate about building unified IT solutions that simplify the way IT organizations work. We are currently looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team in the Platform Engineering organization and help us scale our products to millions of end-users. We are looking for individuals with a passion for automation and observability, ensuring the quality and availability of our services.

Location: We are flexible on remote working from home, but you must be located in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, or Mexico .

  • Intermediate+ level Linux administration, scripting, and troubleshooting.

  • Demonstrable knowledge of observability tools (New Relic, Splunk, DataDog).

  • Comprehensive experience with AWS (Amazon Web Services) and its core capabilities (VPC, EC2, ECS, Route53, Fargate, ALB/NLB distributions, etc).

  • Experience with cloud automation and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) toolsets, primarily CloudFormation but also including Terraform, Helm, and Ansible. CDK a plus.

  • Good understanding of containers, Fargate, Kubernetes, and overall distributed microservice architectures.

  • Passionate about automation, security, and self-service environments/portals.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) processes.

  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.

NinjaOne automates the hardest parts of IT to deliver visibility, security, and control over all endpoints for more than 20,000 customers. The NinjaOne automated endpoint management platform is proven to increase productivity, reduce security risk, and lower costs for IT teams and managed service providers. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and provides free and unlimited onboarding, training, and support. NinjaOne is #1 on G2 in endpoint management, patch management, remote monitoring and management, and mobile device management.

Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally. Develop your skills through our renowned training platform. Receive competitive compensation. Collaborate with an amazing international workforce.

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We are a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles, meeting in person 2-4 times yearly in interesting locations worldwide.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer for our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is ideal for an automation-first senior technologist passionate about Linux, aiming to build a career with Canonical and support those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience in IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code, and a passion for technology, you'll thrive here.

Job Summary

The IS team supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services, serving over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops Engineer, you'll drive operations automation in our private and public clouds using open source infrastructure as code tools, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's automation products. You will also provide feedback to developers to improve product operation at scale, contribute to open source projects, and collaborate across teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead automation and Gitops initiatives as a technical lead within your team.
  • Align solutions with the IS architecture vision by collaborating with the IS architect.
  • Design and develop services to be offered as products by IS.
  • Advance infrastructure as code practices, increasing automation and process improvements.
  • Automate software operations across clouds, considering distributed system complexities.
  • Maintain operational responsibility for core services, networks, and infrastructure.
  • Enhance troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance monitoring using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch.
  • Support and collaborate with global engineering, operations, and support teams.
  • Focus on larger projects and automation during dedicated development time.
  • Share expertise through design sessions, mentorship, and collaborative work.
  • Handle time-critical escalations responsibly.

Qualifications

  • Experience with hosting architecture driven by infrastructure as code across private and public clouds.
  • Product mindset focused on developing products rather than just solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python, especially with large projects.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration systems.
  • Proven ability to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls.
  • Familiarity with Linux storage solutions like Ceph and databases.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud computing concepts and technologies.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or related field.
  • Effective communication skills in English via multiple channels.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills from kernel to web, with a collaborative attitude.
  • Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to fast-changing environments.
  • Comfort working within distributed teams.
  • Passion for open source, especially Ubuntu or Debian.

What We Offer

Competitive global compensation, annual reviews, performance bonuses, and benefits aligned with our values. Additional perks include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Recognition rewards, annual leave, parental leave, wellness programs, and travel opportunities.

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster a discrimination-free workplace. Working here challenges you to think differently, learn continually, and excel.

This position will be based in our Office in Brazil in a full in person work model.

Position Summary:

The digital workplace head is responsible for the strategy and management of digital workplace technologies and services, ensuring a seamless digital employee experience (DEX). This role covers all functions of the digital workplace, including the service desk management, budgeting, and IT asset management (hardware and software), enhancing digital dexterity, and driving positive business outcomes, while maintaining compliance with SOX and ITGC controls.

Main responsibilities:

  • Reporting to Infrastructure Head and partner with the CIO/CTO, human resources, facilities and other IT and business leaders to set the strategic direction of the digital workplace and DEX improvements.
  • Lead the digital workplace operations team focused on fulfilling (telephony included) end-user support and service requests, including the IT service desk, the VIP and desktop support, A/V support, Active Directory, IT services catalogue and IT asset management (hardware & software) inventory.
  • Manage the annual budget for operating and capital expenditures and govern digital workplace technology usage, standards, and licensing to align with IT and company objectives while optimizing costs and enforcing data policies.
  • Contract administration including management of service level for services in the scope including licensing expiration, renewal with different services providers and procurement team.
  • Lead the development, publication and maintenance of the corporate IT catalogue of product and services and its roadmap aligned with business requirements and IT leaders.
  • Provide IT leaders and business with a consolidated overview of IT Service Support KPIs (support tickets and service requests) submitted by the business area, ensuring adherence to SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
  • Champion the modernization of workforce technology and services to enable new ways of working and digital transformation, while demonstrating digital dexterity and fostering a culture of workforce digital dexterity by leading adoption, enablement, and influence to achieve digital business goals.
  • Partner with HR to understand employees’ current challenges, new roles, demographic changes, mobility, hybrid work and more, incorporating this knowledge into digital workplace planning, while utilizing organizational change management best practices to drive technology adoption.
  • Partner with corporate real estate/facilities to create a smart workplace that supports hybrid and remote workers as much as onsite workers.
  • Collaborate with colleagues in internal communications to communicate how digital workplace applications benefit employees through enablement campaigns and measurement of customer satisfaction and eNPS.
  • Work with IT security and risk management to ensure that digital workplace technologies comply with corporate policies and industry standards.
  • Responsible for SOX and ITGC controls within the digital workplace, including the polices creation or update ensuring flawless execution and developing action plans for improvements when necessary.


Main requirements:

  • (5+) years managing IT systems, processes and vendors.
  • (5+) years of leading digital workplace team and processes including external service desk services
  • English mandatory
  • Experience with vendor governance, KPI Management, including demonstrated success in conducting RFPs and vendor service transitions.
  • Proven financial management skills with operational budget tasks.
  • Awareness of ways to measure Digital Experience and satisfaction.
  • Working knowledge of IT frameworks such as ITIL, including key processes – knowledge, incident, change, service request and major-incident management.
  • Proven ability to manage rapidly changing business priorities, processes and technologies.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of digital workplace applications.

Work Environment:

It isn’t just the performance that matters. We also care about the way we achieve our targets. We see our way of working as a differentiator, which contributes to retain the best team, to establish long-term relationships with clients, to expand to other countries, and to attract investors and partners who allow us to generate superior returns:

title: [Talent Pool] Investor XP | Porto Alegre
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Porto Alegre. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial em Porto Alegre e proximidades.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Waste Management Specialist (Summer 2025-2026) - Palmer Station
description:
POSITION: Waste Management Specialist

SEASON: Austral Summer (October - April)

LOCATION: Palmer Station, Antarctica

SECTOR/DEPT: Six Mile, LLC Antarctica

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Act as point of contact for Waste Management and attend weekly staff meetings and teleconferences.
  2. Collect and package for shipment all solid and hazardous wastes on station.
  3. Follow all SOPs associated with position duties.
  4. Ensure proper documentation and filing of all paperwork on time.
  5. Review/update JHA and SDS binders and computer folders.
  6. Use proper PPE for various tasks (correct gloves, respirator, safety glasses, etc.).
  7. Quality check all shipping containers and correct discrepancies immediately.
  8. Process hazardous and radioactive waste per SOPs, including marking, labeling, weighing, and storing.
  9. Perform classification qualitative testing on items (pH testing, flash point testing, etc.).
  10. Consolidate and lab pack wastes as required per profile and classification.
  11. Safely operate various pieces of equipment on station (SkyTraks, ATVs, etc.).
  12. Store processed hazardous wastes according to segregation requirements.
  13. Keep waste inventory records updated and accurate.
  14. Perform quality-assurance checks on inventory database and files.
  15. Provide hazardous waste, solid waste, and spill briefings.
  16. Act as Spill Team Lead for the entire station, write spill reports, and conduct trainings and drills.
  17. Organize, orient, and train members of Spill Team for outside spill response.
  18. Maintain inventory of spill supplies in spill-vans and satellite spill kits.
  19. Assist station mechanic with weekly station fueling activities.
  20. Maintain/deploy spill-boom supplies for station fueling.
  21. Assist with general station needs, including snow removal and radio communications.
  22. Conduct community Waste Briefs or other informational sessions as necessary.
  23. Collect and process Resale Items as needed.
  24. Maintain Maximo Resale work orders and provide end of season report to McMurdo Resale Admin and ASC Property Manager.
  25. Maintain a flexible schedule based on Vessel Operations and other station-wide activities.
  26. Ensure seasonal replacement receives proper training and maintain a log of this information.
  27. Troubleshoot any issues that arise and elevate them as needed.
  28. Supply manual labor (shoveling) for several hours if needed.
  29. Perform regular use of drum dollies, cargo straps, banding, shovels, pallet jacks, power tools, and other tools.
  30. Engage in regular physical activity, including bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and gripping.
  31. Display self-motivation in a physically challenging and atypical work environment; position is approximately 70% outdoor tasking.
  32. Maintain flexibility and a positive attitude in a dynamic, fast-paced work setting.
  33. Perform duties in support of Operations Division metrics.
  34. Support the achievement of ASC metrics.
  35. Comply with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements.
  36. Work to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  37. Maintain a safe workplace and ensure that safety is the highest priority.
  38. Perform other duties as required.
  39. Reports to Hazardous Waste Manager and Solid Waste Manager.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. 2 years of USAP Waste Management experience.
  2. College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).
  3. Strong computer software experience.
  4. Able to lift 50 pounds consistently and wear a respirator.
  5. Valid Driver's License and Passport valid for six months after contract end.
  6. Physically able to be active for 9 hours daily.
  7. Must pass physical qualification assessment.
  8. Able to deploy to Antarctica for length of contract.

PREFERRED:

  1. 1 year of Hazardous Materials shipping/characterization or reporting experience or 2 years of Environmental remediation.
  2. 1 year of supervisory experience.
  3. 1 year of High School Chemistry or equivalent.
  4. 1 quarter of college General Chemistry.
  5. College degree in Chemistry or Environmental Science.
  6. OSHA HazWOPER 40-Hour certification, current.
  7. Familiarity with power tools and machinery.
  8. Equipment operating experience.
  9. Previous management or supervisory experience.

EDUCATION:

College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).

CERTIFICATIONS AND/OR LICENSING REQUIREMENTS:

Valid Driver's License and passport valid for six months after end of contract.

OTHER:

US citizenship or permanent residency required.

A prerequisite of employment for this position is to successfully gain a favorable Tier 1 - Elevated Background Investigation (EBI) result prior to deployment.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Horário: De segunda à sexta, das 8h às 18h com horário de almoço
Modalidade: Presencial
Descrição:

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Inspeções e Auditorias de Segurança

• Realizar inspeções periódicas nas instalações da empresa para identificar riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.

• Conduzir auditorias internas e externas em conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e demais legislações aplicáveis.

• Acompanhar as condições de trabalho, instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, promovendo melhorias contínuas nas práticas de segurança.

2. Gestão e Implementação de Normas de Segurança

• Garantir o cumprimento das normas legais e internas de segurança do trabalho, por meio da elaboração, revisão e atualização de procedimentos.

• Supervisionar e garantir o uso correto dos Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e Coletiva (EPCs), orientando os colaboradores quanto à sua utilização.

3. Treinamentos e Conscientização

• Planejar e realizar treinamentos periódicos de segurança, primeiros socorros, combate a incêndios, manuseio de EPIs e operação segura de máquinas.

• Promover campanhas e ações de conscientização voltadas à cultura de prevenção de acidentes.

• Conduzir simulados de evacuação e resposta a emergências.

4. Investigação de Acidentes e Incidentes

• Investigar acidentes e quase acidentes, identificando causas raízes e elaborando planos de ação corretiva e preventiva.

• Emitir relatórios técnicos com análises e indicadores de desempenho em segurança.

5. Gestão de Documentação e Relatórios

• Manter atualizados os registros legais e operacionais de segurança do trabalho: controle de EPIs, treinamentos, PPRA/PGR, PCMSO, LTCAT, CAT, entre outros.

• Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de SST para acompanhamento estratégico da área.

6. Gestão de Riscos Ambientais e Ocupacionais

• Identificar, avaliar e controlar riscos ambientais e ocupacionais, conforme legislação vigente.

• Apoiar ações de controle de substâncias químicas, descarte de resíduos e demais práticas de segurança ambiental.

7. Gestão de Terceiros e Prestadores de Serviços

• Acompanhar e garantir que os terceiros cumpram os requisitos legais e internos de segurança durante suas atividades na empresa.

• Elaborar, revisar e validar documentação de segurança exigida de terceiros (como PCMSO, PGR, ASO, treinamentos e permissões de trabalho).

• Promover integração e treinamentos específicos de segurança para terceiros, reforçando o alinhamento com a cultura da empresa.

8. Gestão do AVCB (Auto de Vistoria do Corpo de Bombeiros)

• Gerir o processo de obtenção, renovação e manutenção do AVCB da empresa.

• Coordenar as adequações necessárias para atendimento às exigências do Corpo de Bombeiros, como sistemas de combate a incêndios, sinalizações e rotas de fuga.

• Manter controle rigoroso sobre a validade e documentação de licenças relacionadas à segurança contra incêndio.

9. Gestão do eSocial – Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho (SST)

• Garantir o correto preenchimento e envio das informações de SST no eSocial, dentro dos prazos legais.

• Trabalhar em conjunto com o RH para atualização dos eventos de segurança e saúde ocupacional.

• Controlar e registrar eventos como acidentes de trabalho, exames médicos e treinamentos obrigatórios no sistema.

10. Apoio em Projetos de Segurança e Melhoria Contínua

• Participar da implementação de projetos e soluções voltadas à melhoria da segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

• Atuar de forma consultiva com outras áreas, promovendo a integração da segurança com os processos produtivos e administrativos.

11. Gestão Patrimonial e Operacional de Serviços Terceirizados

• Monitorar e controlar a integridade do patrimônio da empresa, incluindo instalações, equipamentos e áreas comuns.

• Supervisionar os serviços terceirizados de portaria, vigilância, jardinagem e limpeza, assegurando o cumprimento de cronogramas, padrões de qualidade e normas de segurança.

• Garantir que os prestadores de serviços patrimoniais estejam devidamente documentados, treinados e integrados às políticas da empresa.

• Atuar na melhoria contínua dos serviços terceirizados, propondo ajustes contratuais, treinamentos ou reestruturações quando necessário.

• Acompanhar e auditar o uso e conservação de áreas comuns, zelando pela ordem, segurança e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho.


Requisitos:

Requisitos

• Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho (com registro ativo).

• Experiência anterior na função, preferencialmente no setor industrial.

• Conhecimento aprofundado das NRs e da legislação vigente.

• Experiência comprovada em gestão de terceiros e controle documental de prestadores de serviços.

• Vivência em gestão de riscos ambientais e ocupacionais.

• Domínio da plataforma eSocial, com foco nos eventos de SST.

• Experiência na gestão do AVCB e rotinas de segurança contra incêndio.

• Vivência com gestão patrimonial (limpeza, vigilância, portaria, manutenção predial).

• Habilidade para ministrar treinamentos, elaborar relatórios técnicos e conduzir investigações.

• Habilidades com KPI SST

• Perfil proativo, organizado, com boa comunicação e foco em resultados.

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to Know ourTeam:

The Marketing Innovations Team at Agoda identifies & develops new marketing channels that have high growth potential. This department is highly creative, data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that ensure Agoda’s leadership in the new & emerging channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Marketing Innovations Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll getto:

  • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda's new & emerging marketing channels
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
